gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed patients with histopathological diagnosis of WHO grade IV glioma (GBM).

candidate_evidence.quote: ITI-1001 DNA vaccine represents a multi-antigen nucleic acid cancer immunotherapy encoding 3 CMV antigens.
ITI-1001 vaccinations will be given in combination with Td toxoid.

candidate_flag.reason: Td toxoid is a licensed (non-cancer) vaccine given with the DNA vaccine; if not treated as an excluded vaccine type it could be read as a candidate.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Immunogenicity and Preliminary Efficacy of ITI-1001 In Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma (GBM)

role_evidence.quote: ITI-1001 DNA vaccine represents a multi-antigen nucleic acid cancer immunotherapy encoding 3 CMV antigens.

agents.drug_class_hint: ITI-1001, plasmid DNA cancer vaccine encoding CMV IE-1, pp65 and gB antigens fused to LAMP1, given IM with electroporation

role_evidence.quote: ITI-1001 vaccinations will be given in combination with Td toxoid.

agents.drug_class_hint: tetanus and diphtheria toxoid vaccine, used as immune adjunct to the cancer vaccine

flag.reason: Licensed non-cancer vaccine used as immune adjunct; role as excluded vaccine type vs candidate/supportive needs adjudication.

role_evidence.quote: Planned standard adjuvant chemoradiation (SOC RT + TMZ for 6 weeks).
5 ITI-1001 vaccine boosters given in parallel with maintenance TMZ as per Schedule of Assessments.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: CMV proteins pp65, IE1 and gB in tumour tissue (with CD8, CD163, FOXP3) by IHC

source_quote.quote: IHC detects cytomegalovirus (CMV) proteins pp65, IE1, and Glycoprotein B (gB) in human glioblastoma multiforme tissues as well as the CMV markers (CD8, CD163, and FOXP3), to observe how various HCMV proteins could contribute to GBM pathogenesis.

coder_notes: Only investigational agent is the ITI-1001 DNA cancer vaccine (excluded intervention type), so S6 fails. Td toxoid accompanies the vaccine (not a registered intervention but given to all patients); coded excluded_intervention_type as a vaccine and flagged. Temozolomide is part of SOC chemoradiation and maintenance. Immune-response endpoints (ELISpot, flow cytometry) relate to the vaccine, which is not a candidate, so target_engagement_planned coded no. Electroporation device (TDS-IM) not listed as an agent.
